headline: Greek 10-Year Borrowing Costs Fall Below Italian and French Levels
summary: Greek 10-year bond yields dropped below those of Italy and France following a credit rating upgrade by KBRA as Greece's debt-to-GDP ratio nears Italy's.
why: Sovereign yield spreads reflect perceived credit risk; narrowing or negative spreads against larger eurozone peers indicate improving fiscal credibility.

impacts.name: Greece 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Improved credit ratings and fiscal metrics reduce Greek sovereign borrowing yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
